about: One brief per Antheo skill, and for six of them a beginner and a senior wording with the same checks (persona, of). Run each brief twice with any coding agent (no design skill, then reading only the named skill), write the results into two folders, and grade both with run.mjs. Checks are measured on the rendered page or the written answer; nothing is judged by eye. See README.md.
rules: Visual briefs: one self-contained index.html (inline CSS and JS, no frameworks, no external images; one Google Font is allowed). Real-sounding content. It must look right at a 900px wide window, in light mode, unless the brief says otherwise.
Answer briefs: write the reply to answer.md, as you would reply in a chat, and nothing else. Read the files in fixtures/<id>/ first.
No comments or text that name a skill, a person, a company or a design system.
Don't ask questions; make the sensible choice.
